The '''Hutt Championships''' was a series of five podracing courses on [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] worlds.

#[[Serres Sarrano]] ([[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]])
#[[Grand Reefs]] ([[Dac/Legends|Dac]])
#[[Citadel (Gamorr)|Citadel]] ([[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]])
#[[Nightlands/Legends|Nightlands]] ([[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]])
#[[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] ([[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]])

This series was preceded by the [[Podracing Open]] and the [[Galactic Trials]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Hutt Championships was the third and last podracing tournament faced by players in the game ''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]''.
